test_chrono_system_clock: test the pybind11 chrono module system clock binding by calling test_chrono1 and comparing against Python datetime
test_chrono_roundtrip: test roundtrip conversion of Python datetime objects through the C++ chrono binding using test_chrono2
test_chrono_duration_roundtrip: test roundtrip conversion of Python timedelta objects through the C++ chrono binding using test_chrono3
test_chrono_steady_clock: test the pybind11 chrono steady clock binding by calling test_chrono5 and verifying timedelta return type
test_floating_point_duration: test conversion of floating point seconds to timedelta using test_chrono7 and test_chrono_float_diff
